macos.notes: _unverified: package name tracks the current LTS line; versioned formulae are keg-only, so {brew_opt:node@24}/bin must be on PATH (setup-user-shell managed block, plans/tooling-resolution-and-artifact-registry.md A2) or the post-check reports NOT-ON-PATH. Observed on nobul-mac 2026-10-20 (brew info node@22 --json; which -a node): node@22 22.22.3 is installed, keg_only (versioned_formula), and not on PATH; `node` resolves to /opt/homebrew/bin/node -> Cellar/node/26.3.1 (the non-preferred homebrew-current formula). The registry's macOS lastVerifiedVersion 24.1.0 matches neither. Under the tree this machine is class non-preferred (homebrew-current); [r]eplace installs the preferred formula and then stops at REPLACE-BLOCKED (its keg-only opt bin is not on PATH), keeping `node` working. M4 must solve PATH for keg-only formulae before replace can complete. The package line here (node@24) is illustrative; the observed preferred line today is node@22.

The previous preferred line, kept as a non-preferred method so installs on it are not reclassified as unknown (check 10). Installed, keg-only and off PATH on nobul-mac.
